description: Them variant thu hai voi SKU/Color/Size TRUNG y het variant 88621 (QA-SKU-BLACK-M / Black / M / 19.99)

entries.label: mapped

request_body.query: query getVariant($fulfillmentLinkedId: String!, $productId: bigint!) { variants(where: {fulfillment_linked_id: {_eq: $fulfillmentLinkedId}, product_id: {_eq: $productId}}, limit: 1) { id } }

entries.note: Portal tu pre-check trung SKU bang query nay TRUOC khi insert. Vi tim thay -> KHONG gui insert_variants. Pham vi unique la (product_id, fulfillment_linked_id), khong phai toan store.

no_insert_note: Khong co mutation insert_variants nao duoc gui. UI hien toast nguyen van: 'The SKU "QA-SKU-BLACK-M" already exists.'
